plugin.name: Packages
plugin.description: See and install updates on your hosts, search, install and remove packages, and read the package history.

use.title: Use Packages
use.description: See packages and updates on hosts you can reach, and change them on hosts you can edit.

enable.label: Packages
enable.description: Manage packages and updates on this host from the Packages tab.

useSudo.label: Use sudo
useSudo.description: Use sudo to install, update and remove packages. Turn off if the login is root.

readOnly.label: Read only
readOnly.description: Show packages and updates but never change them on this host.

tab.title: Packages
tab.error: Could not load packages from this host.
tab.disabled: Packages is turned off for this host. Turn it on in the host settings.
tab.sudo: Changes need a root login, passwordless sudo or a saved Sudo Password on this host.
tab.noManagerTitle: No supported package manager was found
tab.noManagerHint: Packages works with apt, dnf, yum, zypper, pacman and apk.
tab.reboot: This host needs a reboot to finish an update.

actions.working: {{action}} is running. This can take a few minutes.

refresh.label: Refresh index
refresh.done: The package index is up to date.

upgrade-all.label: Upgrade all
upgrade-all.desc: Refreshes the package index and installs every update. Services may restart while it runs.
upgrade-all.done: All packages are up to date.

remove.label: Remove
remove.desc: Removes {{names}} from this host. Programs that need it may stop working.

hold.label: Hold at this version
hold.desc: Updates will skip {{names}} until you release it.

installed.loadFailed: Could not read the installed packages.

search.hint: Search the host's repositories for a package to install.

history.loadFailed: Could not read the package history.

repos.hint: The repositories this host installs from. Change them on the host itself.

card.title: Package updates
card.empty: Turn on Packages for a host to see its updates here.

manager.title: Packages
manager.disabled: Turn on Packages for this host in its settings to see its updates here.

operations.packageHint: One or more package names, split by spaces.
